fields.description: static fields written into the payload (${VAR}/${constants.x} substituted at load)

from_meta.description: meta keys copied into the payload under the same name; missing keys are skipped

wrap_field.description: when the payload is NOT an object, wrap it as {wrap_field: payload} before applying from_meta/fields (e.g. msg for raw text and stack traces); no effect on object payloads
